definitions.intent: Check exact retained source explanations while preserving missing evidence and unresolved analysis.
invariants: Known unmet required obligations remain FAIL; unsupported observations remain UNKNOWN.
limits: A passing source fact cannot establish complete behavioral qualification.

definitions.intent: Generate inspectable explanations using fixed bounded rules and authored associations.
invariants: Known unmet required obligations remain FAIL; unsupported observations remain UNKNOWN.
limits: Compilation success is an authoring result, not gate clearance.

definitions.intent: Retain syntactic relationships and unresolved consumers for the exact selected changes.
invariants: Known unmet required obligations remain FAIL; unsupported observations remain UNKNOWN.
limits: Resolved syntax does not establish runtime compatibility or complete consumer discovery.

definitions.intent: Distinguish required absent checks, reported outcomes and authenticated execution.
invariants: Known unmet required obligations remain FAIL; unsupported observations remain UNKNOWN.
limits: A result digest and reported pass do not authenticate test execution.

definitions.intent: Project canonical authored intent into only explicitly managed comment blocks.
invariants: Known unmet required obligations remain FAIL; unsupported observations remain UNKNOWN.
limits: Authored explanations do not prove implementation correspondence or historical authorship.

definitions.intent: Run explicitly selected pinned comment, lint and formatting checks without source fixes.
invariants: Known unmet required obligations remain FAIL; unsupported observations remain UNKNOWN.
limits: Check results establish only their selected policy and exact source scope.

definitions.intent: Retain final selected source bytes and check outcomes before any separately authorized promotion.
invariants: Known unmet required obligations remain FAIL; unsupported observations remain UNKNOWN.
limits: Preparation success cannot issue polished status, human acceptance or publication authority.
